item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #345
item.description: Wayland acquires Kraken Wargames and print-on-demand prices rise. Read our curated collection of TTRPG news, featuring fresh Kickstarters, bundle deals, and the latest roleplaying releases.

item.title: RPG Publisher Spotlight: GearGames brings the 90s back with High School Cthulhu
item.description: Your votes made GearGames the RPG Publisher Spotlight for December. We explore their hit High School Cthulhu and the studio's cinematic style.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #318 – Cthulhu School and the He-Man mess
item.description: Episode 318 features a spotlight on GearGames, a breakdown of the new Masters of the Universe trailer and a review of Chris Pratt's Mercy. We also discuss AI playing Dungeons & Dragons, interview Duncan Rhodes and cover the latest Hasbro board appointments.

item.title: Hasbro lawsuit claims “gross mismanagement” and overprinted ‘Magic: The Gathering’ cards
item.description: A lawsuit filed earlier this month against Magic: The Gathering owner Hasbro accuses the company of gross mismanagement, breach of fiduciary duties, and the performance of 'unjust enrichment' by overproducing cards for the beloved game - to the tune of millions.

item.title: The Brick Clog: LEGO’s bizarre new footwear collaboration
item.description: Looking for the ultimate geek fashion statement? The new LEGO x Crocs Brick Clog is a literal building block for your feet, launching this February.

item.title: Sleepy Hollow: Folk Horror with Year Zero
item.description: The mist rises in the Pocantico River valley. Explore the Sleepy Hollow RPG bundle, a Year Zero Engine game of 1810 folk horror. Get the core rules, bestiaries, and campaigns for a bargain price.

item.title: Hunt or be hunted? Kobold Press unleashes Night Hunters
item.description: Kobold Press brings gothic horror to 5E and Tales of the Valiant with Night Hunters. Back the Kickstarter before Friday the 13th of February.

item.title: Limited Collector’s Pack Revealed for Castles & Crusades 11th Printing
item.description: Troll Lord Games opens pre-orders for the 11th printing of the Castles & Crusades Player’s Handbook, featuring a limited edition $99 collector’s bundle.

item.title: Vice Press reveals green Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles VHS collection
item.description: Vice Press is celebrating the 1990 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles movie with a limited edition green VHS release and restored theatrical posters.

item.title: Short film: CLANKER
item.description: Jefferson Blunt spent 121 hours animating CLANKER, a brutal short film pitting human resistance against robotic "clankers" in a war-torn landscape.
